descriptionHtml: The official opening ceremony for IEEE Day 2026 at the University of Peradeniya. The session includes a welcome address, lighting of oil lamps, an introduction to IEEE Day and the society, and an address by the Student Branch Advisor. It also features introductory sessions from multiple student chapters including the Communications Society, Computer Society, Power & Energy Society, Women in Engineering, and the Industry Applications Society.
venue: Prof. E.O.E. Pereira Theatre, Faculty of Engineering
